cards.hint: Recall the opening age listed for the planet itself
cards.quote: Earth is about 4.6 billion years old?
cards.stem: What numeric age for Earth do geologists seek to explain with radioactivity?

cards.hint: Think of the age tied to deposited rocks with early fossils
cards.quote: The oldest known fossils are from rocks that were deposited about 3.5 billion years ago?
cards.stem: How old are the rocks with the oldest known fossils described at the start?

cards.hint: Focus on the age linked to shelly fossils in rock
options: Earth is about 4.6 billion years old
cards.quote: The first abundant shelly fossils occur in rocks that are about 570 million years old?
cards.stem: How old are the rocks holding the first abundant shelly fossils?

every card has distinct options after normalisation (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
